description: This file implements an analog watch face for Wear OS devices with a moving second hand, handling rendering of watch hands, background, and ambient mode features. It extends CanvasWatchFaceService and contains an inner Engine class managing the drawing and lifecycle.

classes.name: AnalogWatchFaceService
classes.description: Main service class for the analog watch face, extending CanvasWatchFaceService.

classes.name: AnalogWatchFaceService.Engine
classes.description: Inner class responsible for handling drawing, lifecycle, and interaction of the watch face.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes watch face style, paints, loads background, and palette extraction.

methods.name: onPropertiesChanged
methods.description: Handles hardware properties like low-bit ambient and burn-in protection.

methods.name: onTimeTick
methods.description: Redraws the watch face every minute in ambient mode.

methods.name: onAmbientModeChanged
methods.description: Adjusts drawing styles based on ambient mode, changing anti-aliasing and colors.

methods.name: onInterruptionFilterChanged
methods.description: Dims the display when in mute mode.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Handles resizing, scales background images, and generates gray background for ambient.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Core method that renders the watch face, including background, tick marks, and watch hands.

methods.name: onVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Registers or unregisters receivers based on visibility, and updates time.

methods.name: updateWatchHandStyle
methods.description: Adjusts paint properties depending on ambient mode.

methods.name: updateTimer
methods.description: Starts or stops the update handler based on visibility and mode.

methods.name: shouldTimerBeRunning
methods.description: Determines if the update timer should run (active and visible).
